title: 2011 Kolding Sequence — Psychonaut Experiment, Tree/Oneness Episode, Psychiatric Admission and Aftermath
status: canonical autobiographical owner with unresolved variants
subject: Thomas / the Son
purpose: Own the detailed 2011 chronology so other timelines can project from one source without collapsing the acute psychedelic episode, the next-day perceptual rupture, psychiatric admission, hospital dream/crows, and later Potatoverse interpretation into one event.
epistemic_rule: This record preserves autobiographical recollection and later interpretation. It does not establish a chemical identity, supernatural perception, or a psychiatric diagnosis. Later mythology must not be backdated as contemporaneous 2011 language.

prehistory.immediate_chain: Designia/Louise → Aabenraa internship while relationship continues → school/internship path ends → own place → Produktionsskolen in Lunderskov → leaves Produktionsskolen → breakup/search corridor → 2011 Kolding Tree/psychiatric sequence.
prehistory.important_boundary: Direct recollection says the Son had already stopped attending Produktionsskolen before the Tree episode.
prehistory.why_this_matters: The Tree episode should not be presented as if it arose directly from a failed internship. The recovered Produktionsskolen period adds an intervening phase of technical competence, multimedia work and informal assistant-teacher responsibility.

biographical_setting.home_context: Thomas was living in an apartment in Kolding during the relevant period.
biographical_setting.social_context: Friends around him were interested in psychoactive drugs, research chemicals, chemistry and altered-state experimentation.
biographical_setting.broader_context: Thomas was unemployed / in psychiatric-system contact, was seeking ADD/ADHD assessment, and was simultaneously using psychonautic experimentation to investigate consciousness, meaning and the effects of psychoactive substances.

substance_reconstruction.remembered_amount: approximately 20–25 mg if the 2C-series recollection is correct
substance_reconstruction.unit_note: The remembered number is consistent with milligram-scale 2C-series dosing, not micrograms; this pharmacological plausibility does not identify the substance.
substance_reconstruction.archive_rule: Do not silently choose 2C-E, 2C-I, or mushrooms as fact until a contemporaneous source or other strong evidence resolves the variant.

working_event_order.description: Thomas ingests a semi-large first-use amount of the unresolved psychedelic / research chemical in his Kolding apartment while friends are present.

For roughly the first hour, bodily and autonomic sensations move in waves: heat/cold, dryness/moisture, nausea, gastrointestinal and urinary sensations, anxious or thrilling sensations in the abdomen, differing limb sensations, and a strong background body load. Thomas later calls this a chameleon-like phase.

As the turbulent body phase eases, mechanical vibration and music become intensely salient. Goa and dubstep are remembered; sound appears as visible spectrum or rainbow-like structure coming from speakers.
While friends are still present, Thomas reports visual-emotional imagery around people, including flames / demons, and an unusually strong sense of perceiving mood or information from them.
Before or around the friends' departure, autobiographical memories flash rapidly. Thomas reports that events are present but the ordinary central self is absent from them.

After the friends leave, the experience becomes more internal and unitary: fractal carpet patterns, objects appearing to transform or rotate within themselves, time perceived as stereo, a continuously moving spiral associated with time, recursive scale, the world experienced as an ocean or continuous field, the room breathing with Thomas, and matter / objects experienced as informational or communicative.

Thomas reports hearing or sensing vibrations, wind, conversation and mood beyond normal boundaries and experiencing trees and objects as communicative. These are preserved as subjective altered-state experiences, not as independently established extrasensory access.
The acute episode gradually subsides. The archive preserves an overall ordeal of about 19 hours and a roughly six-hour unity phase.
working_event_order.duration_status: unresolved whether the six-hour unity phase is contained within the roughly nineteen hours or was additional in some older retellings

working_event_order.description: After sleep, Thomas goes shopping. As he approaches and enters a store, noise becomes overwhelming and he experiences what seem to be other people's internal voices. He interprets this as a sign that ordinary perceptual boundaries have not fully returned.
Thomas voluntarily presents to psychiatric care because he believes his brain needs rest and a controlled environment in which to return toward baseline.

Because Thomas presents highly altered and disorganized after drug use, clinicians consider psychotic-spectrum explanations. According to later recollection, schizophrenia is considered but never established as the final diagnosis. ADD/ADHD assessment continues while recent drug use and later psychiatric medication complicate interpretation for roughly a year or more.
working_event_order.boundary: Do not state that Thomas had schizophrenia or was definitively misdiagnosed with schizophrenia without primary clinical records.

working_event_order.description: Psychiatric medications are offered / administered. Thomas initially agrees despite reluctance and later refuses further drugs. Retrospectively he includes this medication period inside his broader experiential knowledge of psychoactive effects.
working_event_order.boundary: This was not controlled pharmacological research and should not be framed as equivalent to professional experimental pharmacology.

working_event_order.description: During the hospital period, Thomas has a vivid dream / vision of catastrophic destruction in America involving a nuclear explosion. One older account describes an aerial or drone-like perspective and a scene near Washington / the White House.
working_event_order.event_separation: Keep separate from the acute psychedelic episode unless primary evidence later establishes otherwise.

working_event_order.description: Thomas later wakes and sees an extraordinary real-world crow scene, remembered in some accounts as a dense murder of crows filling or obscuring sky, trees and ground, with a crowd of people also present.

duration_and_age_rules.duration: Approximately 19 hours overall with an approximately six-hour unity phase; do not automatically add the two figures.
duration_and_age_rules.biological_age: With birth on 1987-07-31, the Son was 23 before 2011-07-31 and 24 afterward. Age 25 is impossible in 2011.
duration_and_age_rules.exact_date_status: The exact 2011 event date remains unresolved.

psychiatric_history_rule.preferred_wording: During the 2011 drug-related psychiatric episode, schizophrenia or another psychotic-spectrum explanation was considered because Thomas presented in a highly altered state. According to later recollection, it was not established as the final diagnosis, while ADD/ADHD assessment continued and the effects of recent substance use and medication complicated interpretation.
do_not_write: Thomas was definitively diagnosed with schizophrenia

psychonaut_framing.preferred: serious lay psychonaut practice / psychonautic experimentation
psychonaut_framing.description: The period combines direct altered-state experimentation, interest in chemistry and pharmaceuticals, attention to subjective effects, and philosophical questions about consciousness and reality.
psychonaut_framing.comparison_rule: Alexander Shulgin and Terence McKenna may be used as cultural / methodological comparators, but Thomas should not be equated with Shulgin's professional chemical expertise.

timeline_integration.projection_rule: The pack exposes sub-phases for navigation; this owner remains the chronology authority for the sequence.
